subject: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma
body_text:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma

Hi Laura + Marissa,

Opening this thread to request an exception for Rajesh Varma (IC, Platform Services). Rajesh was moved into my org as part of the Oct reorg (team consolidation) and missed the formal calibration window. Performance review feedback was very strong and the hiring manager escalated for a mid-quarter merit + modest equity refresh to retain him — the ask is 12% merit and 2k RSU refresh (one-time grant).

Why this is sensitive: Rajesh is on a critical customer migration, has received competing offers in the market, and we believe losing him would delay a major deliverable. I attached a short case summary and the calibration matrix we used in our skip-level review.

Requested next steps:
- Can Comp approve a one-time exception for the equity refresh?
- If comp can approve only up to X, I need to know how to escalate for additional budget (finance sign-off).
- HR: what documentation/consent do we need from Rajesh for a mid-cycle grant (paperwork + payroll timing)?

Attachments: [Attachment: comp-case-summary.pdf (3 pages)] [Attachment: calibration-matrix.xlsx]

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:02:44 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma

Thanks for the context, Mina — I reviewed the summary and the calibration notes. A few clarifying Qs before we route to Finance:

1) Is Rajesh currently in an active PIP or any documented performance concerns? (I assume not based on your note.)
2) Is this request replaceable with a cash bonus if RSUs are constrained?
3) Do you have peer comparators from calibration showing the band target percentiles for similar ICs?

Quick note on policy: Comp can approve out-of-cycle merit up to 8% and one-time cash bonuses up to $10k without exec sign-off. Equity refreshes outside the scheduled cycle require either an HR/Comp exception + finance cover or an exec sign-off if the grant exceeds our mid-cycle guidance.

If you can confirm 1–3, I’ll prep a concise memo for Rishi and include a recommended delta (we typically ask managers to propose the preferred structure with cost modeling).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:05:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma

+1 to Laura's notes. I also flagged required HR steps:
- Manager must secure written acceptance from Rajesh for a one-time grant and confirm any tax implication discussions. I can draft the consent form and coordinate with Payroll.
- We need to ensure the grant does not push Rajesh above the local grant cap (APAC vs US localization) — might need Payroll input.
- Timeline: if approved this week, we can execute with the Dec payroll (paperwork by Tues 12/1).

I’ll prepare a short consent draft and pull his current grant history.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:08:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma

Couple of points from Finance perspective:
- We need an estimated annualized run-rate impact (salary uplift + prorated benefits + dilution for RSUs). Mina, can you put numbers for the 12% merit ask vs an 8% baseline? Also include the one-time equity cost in USD (use current strike/valuation assumptions).
- If the request exceeds the mid-cycle comp reserve (IIRC ~$45k for your org), we will need exec approval and to route via the emergency comp fund — please include a clear business justification and impact of losing Rajesh (deliverable dates, customer risk).

I can fast-track sign-off if the cost model is provided and the case meets the bar.

-Rishi
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Susan Payroll <susan@payrollco.com>, Vendor People Ops <vendor-peopleops@example.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sensitive merit/equity exception for org transition — Rajesh Varma

Folks —
Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below and I attached a short run-rate sketch.

1) Performance: No PIP, exemplary feedback from customers and skip-levels.
2) Cash alternative: Manager prefers RSU refresh to signal retention and alignment with long-term roadmap; cash bonus only if RSU approval is denied.
3) Comparators: Attached matrix shows Rajesh falls in the 88th percentile versus IC peers (see highlighted row).

Cost sketch (annualized impact):
- Current base: $180,000
- Proposed base (12% merit): $201,600 (delta $21,600 annualized)
- One-time RSU: $2,000 (market value at grant date) — modeled dilution cost in attached spreadsheet

Requested ask: Approve the 12% merit + 2k RSU one-time refresh. If Comp can only greenlight an 8% merit, please confirm and we will consider a cash topping of $6k to make parity.

HR/Payroll notes: Marissa, Susan — happy to sign consent. Susan, can you confirm tax withholding implications for the Dec payroll cutoff?

If OK, Laura/Rishi — please reply with: (a) approve as requested, (b) approve with limitations (we will accept alternate structure), or (c) require exec sign-off (let me know who to loop).

Attachments: [Attachment: comp-case-summary.pdf] [Attachment: calibration-matrix.xlsx] [Attachment: runrate-sketch.pdf (1 page)]

Thanks,
Mina

--
CONFIDENTIAL: This thread contains sensitive compensation information. Please treat per Redwood HR confidentiality guidelines.
